prepare.label: Building the game from your IPA (first time: downloads about 1 GB of free tools, then about 15 minutes of computing)

exit_codes.3: The game isn't built yet. Use Set Up Again on the game's page, with your FTL IPA.

settings.label: Game window
settings.help: Fullscreen works on Linux and the Steam Deck; the Windows build opens in a window for now.

settings.label: Vertical sync
settings.help: On keeps the picture tear-free at 60 images per second. Turn it off to measure speed.

settings.label: FPS counter
settings.help: Shows the number of images per second.

settings.label: Game sound
settings.help: Turn the sound off if your audio device gives trouble.

settings.label: Record my games
settings.help: Records your inputs and the random seed, so a crash or a bug can be replayed exactly.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Open the folder with your saved games.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: Open the folder with the build and game logs.

actions.label: Recordings
actions.help: Open the folder with recorded games.
